description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Request which encapsulates an XML-RPC request, including method name, parameters, and XML serialization/deserialization logic. It also manages faults related to request parsing and validation.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Request
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC request, capable of loading from XML, setting method and parameters, and generating the XML request string.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with optional method name and parameters.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the request and related values.

methods.name: setMethod
methods.description: Sets the method name to invoke via XML-RPC, with validation.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the request, with optional type hinting.

methods.name: setParams
methods.description: Sets multiple parameters at once, accepting either an array of parameter values or an array of associative arrays with 'value' and 'type'.

methods.name: getParams
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter values.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of parameter types.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string into request components, setting method and parameters.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Indicates if the current request has a fault due to parsing or validation errors.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Returns the fault object if any.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcParams
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve parameters as Zend_XmlRpc_Value objects for XML serialization.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the request into an XML-RPC methodCall string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the XML request string by calling saveXml.
